messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — we need to pick a default approach for telemetry redaction. Masking (replace with <REDACTED>) vs tokenization/deterministic hashing. Goal: keep traces useful for debugging and QoS alerts without exposing PII.
Tom: Short answer: mix. Use deterministic hashing for identifiers we need to correlate, masking for free-text PII. Salt per-tenant so hashes aren't cross-tenant linkable.
Diego: Agreed. Also consider sampling tiering: 100% for high-priority customers, 10% for default, 0.1% for bulk. We need to ensure sampling works post-redaction.
Rina: What about console previews? Product wants a short prompt snippet visible in traces for triage.
Alyssa: Proposal: show 64 chars preview with redaction applied. Allow an audit toggle for authorized roles to see sanitized-but-not-raw (e.g., hashed ids) behind an RBAC gate.
Maria (security): :shield: Legal prefers non-reversible transforms for emails/SSNs. Hashing is reversible if salted and attacker knows salt. For regulated data we must redact fully unless explicit consent+auditing.
Tom: Noted. We can treat 'sensitive fields' list as fully redacted: email, ssn, cc numbers. Everything else use deterministic hash. We should let customers opt into 'hashed mode' per workspace settings.
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: `feature/redaction-hash` -> canary 10% -> 100% in 48h. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/redaction-canary
Diego: Implementation detail: runtime extraction via regex + model-assisted PII detector fallback. Regex for emails: `/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/`.
Rina: UX ask: in rollouts console add a per-route toggle for shown-field-length and sampling rate. Mockup: `routes/:id/telemetry` with sliders.
Alyssa: Can we add a separate 'telemetry retention label' so ops can filter logs that are hashed vs redacted quickly?
Tom: yes — annotate traces with `pii_mode: redacted|hashed|none` and `sample_rate`.
Maria (security): Also require KMS for salts; store salt per-customer, rotate quarterly, log rotations to audit-trail.
Diego: One more: for embeddings/outputs we should run hashed placeholder for user text only after tokenization boundary to avoid leaking adjacent tokens.
Rina: :thinking_face: Are we blocking any customers during this? Product needs a FAQ for enterprise.
Alyssa: I'll draft an FAQ. Action items: Tom: spec for modes + RBAC controls. Diego: detector + sampling integration. Maria: compliance checklist. Rina: console wireframes. I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow.
Tom: SGTM :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Meeting created: /cal 30m redaction sync — 1782504800
Alyssa: Thanks all, we'll iterate in the PRs. :eyes:
